meta.name: Studio Due Terra L5
meta.description: This is a Studio Due Terra L5 inground architectural luminaire, a single fixed product with no moving parts. The housing is a short cylinder about 0.19 m across and 0.16 m tall, set flush into the ground with no yoke or arm. A thin flat stainless bezel about 0.19 m across caps the top, with four countersunk screws around its edge. Under a flat round glass disc about 0.11 m across sit four circular LED cells in a loose diamond, spaced about a quarter of the disc diameter apart. The body is probably plain black, though a stepped stainless variant may exist. All four cells dim and mix as one RGBW(+W) group.
